name: PATH Emerging Scholars Program (UNM Health Sciences)
org: University of New Mexico Health Sciences, Office for Diversity, Equity and Inclusion
what_you_do: A one-week program on health careers. Students see clinical or research work, study health equity and do community projects.
grades: High school juniors and seniors (the page also lists rising sophomores)
who_can_apply: New Mexico residents with a valid SSN or ITIN (used for payment only). You need an interest in a health career and leadership. The page says juniors and seniors, and also lists rising sophomores.
pay_detail: A stipend after you finish. The amount is not stated on the program page.
duration: One week, plus a one-day orientation. Summer 2027 dates are not listed.
how_to_apply: Use the online form. You send a student application, a profile with short essays and one recommendation form.
notes: The page does not state an age. Its focus is health care for Black communities and other communities of color.
